keyEndpoints.purpose: Client configuration (login form types, default currency, payment widget). 465 bytes, no odds. Recorded because it is the only API this brand serves.

finding: Serves the same /ro/api/v3/project/info surface as swiper.ro. project/info answers 200 with 465 bytes of client configuration, but every sportsbook path beneath it (/sportsbook/sports, /sportsbook/events) is HTTP 404. Same non-usable shape as swiper: the brand exposes configuration without odds.
